stories.title: Alto Tietê tem mais de 5,1 mil vagas de emprego nesta quarta-feira; veja lista

en.title: Alto Tietê has over 5.1 thousand job openings on Wednesday; see list
en.summary: The Alto Tietê region in São Paulo state has 5,144 job openings across seven municipalities. The positions are offered through municipal and state programs in various sectors and education levels, with both online and in-person application options available.

stories.title: Coliseu de Roma fecha para o público após morte de trabalhador

en.title: Colosseum of Rome closes to public after worker death
en.summary: The Colosseum in Rome closed on Wednesday following the death of a 22-year-old worker who fell from a height while installing a new lighting system. Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni expressed shock at the tragic incident.

stories.title: Linha 9-Esmeralda tem maiores intervalos após risco de deslizamento perto de Interlagos; falha na Linha 5 é normalizada

en.title: Line 9-Emerald has longer intervals after landslide risk near Interlagos; Line 5 failure is normalized
en.summary: São Paulo's Line 9-Emerald operated with extended intervals between two stations on Wednesday due to landslide risks caused by heavy rainfall near a railway embankment. Line 5-Lilac experienced earlier service issues that were subsequently resolved.

stories.title: Resultado da Mega-Sena 3061: 15 apostas do Piauí acertam números; veja valores

en.title: Mega-Sena 3061 Result: 15 bets from Piauí match numbers; see values
en.summary: Fifteen lottery tickets from Piauí state matched four numbers in Mega-Sena draw 3061 held on Tuesday. No ticket won the jackpot, which accumulated to an estimated 38 million reais for the next draw.

stories.title: Eleição para reitor do IFPB acontece nesta quarta-feira (23); veja onde e como votar

en.title: Election for IFPB rector takes place on Wednesday (23); see where and how to vote
en.summary: The Federal Institute of Paraíba will hold an election on Wednesday to select a new rector and general directors for 14 campuses. Voting occurs from 8am to 8pm using paper ballots at all institution locations, with the elected rector serving from 2026 to 2030.

stories.title: Restituição do Imposto de Renda: 6 mil moradores do Vale do Paraíba têm lote residual liberado nesta quarta (23)

en.title: Income Tax refund: 6 thousand residents of Vale do Paraíba have residual batch released on Wednesday (23)
en.summary: The Federal Revenue Service releases access to a residual income tax refund batch for 2026 on Wednesday. In the Vale do Paraíba region, 6,293 refunds totaling R$ 13.164.306,41 are available, with bank deposits scheduled for September 30.

stories.title: São Paulo tem alerta de perigo para tempestade e temperatura máxima de 17°C nesta quarta (23)

en.title: São Paulo has storm danger alert and maximum temperature of 17°C on Wednesday (23)
en.summary: São Paulo will experience another rainy and cold day Wednesday due to a cold front arriving in the Southeast, causing instability throughout the region.

stories.title: Receita abre nesta quarta consulta ao lote residual de restituição; o que fazer se não entrou?

en.title: Federal Revenue opens residual refund batch query on Wednesday; what to do if you didn't get it?
en.summary: The Federal Revenue Service opens access to another 2026 income tax refund batch on Wednesday starting at 9am. Taxpayers can check their status through the Federal Revenue website or mobile app using their tax identification number and birth date.

stories.title: Trump se reúne com Delcy Rodríguez pela primeira vez após captura de Maduro

en.title: Trump meets with Delcy Rodríguez for the first time after capture of Maduro
en.summary: President Trump held a meeting with Delcy Rodríguez following the capture of Maduro.

stories.title: Trump se encontra com líder da Venezuela pela primeira vez desde captura de Maduro

en.title: Trump meets with Venezuelan leader for the first time since capture of Maduro
en.summary: President Donald Trump met with interim Venezuelan leader Delcy Rodríguez at the UN General Assembly on Tuesday in their first in-person meeting.

stories.title: Mega-Sena acumula para R$ 38 milhões; confira os números sorteados

en.title: Mega-Sena accumulates to R$ 38 million; check the drawn numbers
en.summary: No winners matched all six numbers in Mega-Sena draw 3,061 on Tuesday. The prize rolled over to an estimated R$ 38 million for the next drawing, with 39 players matching five numbers and 2,148 matching four numbers.

stories.title: Confira a previsão do tempo para Ivaiporã nesta quarta-feira (23)

en.title: Check the weather forecast for Ivaiporã this Wednesday (23)
en.summary: Ivaiporã is expected to experience temperature variations on Wednesday, with lows around 12°C and highs reaching 29°C, with wind chill possibly dropping to 10°C in early hours.

stories.title: BC da Indonésia mantém taxas de juros inalteradas enquanto monitora a rupia

en.title: Indonesia's central bank maintains interest rates unchanged while monitoring rupiah
en.summary: Indonesia's central bank kept interest rates steady while assessing the impact of rupiah support measures amid renewed currency risks.

stories.title: PMI Composto da França cresce para 51,2, maior nível em 25 meses, puxado por serviços

en.title: France's Composite PMI rises to 51.2, highest level in 25 months, driven by services
en.summary: France's private sector activity expanded in September at its strongest pace in over two years, with services leading the growth.

stories.title: PMI Composto da Alemanha atinge 53,8 em setembro, maior nível em 11 meses

en.title: Germany's Composite PMI reaches 53.8 in September, highest level in 11 months
en.summary: Germany's private sector activity accelerated in September, driven by renewed growth in services and continued industrial expansion.

stories.title: PMI Composto da zona do euro atinge 53,1 em setembro, máxima em 41 meses

en.title: Eurozone Composite PMI reaches 53.1 in September, highest in 41 months
en.summary: Eurozone private sector activity strengthened in September, with growth reaching its fastest pace in nearly three and a half years according to preliminary PMI data.

stories.title: Prévia do PMI do Reino Unido de setembro mostra desaceleração com alta da inflação

en.title: UK preliminary PMI for September shows deceleration amid rising inflation
en.summary: United Kingdom private sector activity continued expanding for a third consecutive month in September but weakened compared to August, facing reduced demand and increasing inflationary pressures.
